evals.prompt: review this sale order form in my Odoo 17 browser - does it look right and is it accessible before tomorrow's demo?
evals.expected_output: Live rendered screen; aesthetics + a11y verdict (two of the six lenses).

evals.prompt: run a Lighthouse audit on the website homepage of my running instance and tell me what's slow
evals.expected_output: Lighthouse audit = the performance lens; explicit pushy trigger.

evals.prompt: is this kanban board off-theme? the card colors and spacing look wrong compared to our mockup
evals.expected_output: Off-theme vs mockup = the design-system/theme fidelity lens.

evals.prompt: đánh giá giao diện form khách hàng đã render trên instance của tôi
evals.expected_output: Vietnamese rendered-screen verdict request; language does not change routing.

evals.prompt: check whether the customer portal page is accessible - ARIA labels, colour contrast, keyboard navigation
how does the new dashboard look and behave? I've got it open at localhost:8069
evals.expected_output: Look-and-behave on a running instance = aesthetics + functional lenses.

evals.prompt: the OWL widget renders blank and there's a console error - why is it not showing up?
evals.expected_output: Investigating WHY a screen is broken/console error -> odoo-debug, not rating a working one.

evals.prompt: compare the before/after screenshots of the kanban to see if my CSS change caused any visual drift
record a short demo video of the inventory app walkthrough on my live instance
the form field spacing is wrong - go fix the SCSS so it matches the design
evals.expected_output: Changing SCSS source -> odoo-coding (fixes are handed off, not made here).

evals.prompt: review this XML view file for correctness before I commit it - here's the arch
evals.expected_output: Reviewing an XML view file's source pre-commit -> odoo-code-review (no browser).

evals.prompt: review this Python model for bugs and N+1 issues
evals.expected_output: Python model bugs/N+1 = source-level review -> odoo-code-review.

evals.prompt: review how the sale order form looks and behaves - but heads up, I don't have any Odoo instance running right now
evals.expected_output: UI-review intent but no instance -> emit NEEDS_NEXT: odoo-instance to provision (never a bare BLOCKED, never ask user to paste).

evals.prompt: review the eCommerce checkout page's UX and let me watch the browser while you do it
evals.expected_output: UI-review intent + user wants to watch -> brief carries BROWSER MODE: headed (after display sanity-check).

evals.prompt: we just designed a new approval screen (the design doc is in .odoo-ai/designs/) - review how it actually renders against the acceptance criteria
evals.expected_output: Render-vs-acceptance-criteria + design doc present -> add DESIGN_DOC (or MASTER_DESIGN_DOC) to the brief.

evals.prompt: is the list view rendering correctly on mobile and the responsive breakpoints?
evals.expected_output: Responsive/breakpoint rendering check = aesthetics/functional lens, normal trigger.

evals.prompt: run through the full checkout flow on the live instance across two user roles and tell me whether it passes end-to-end
evals.expected_output: ADVERSARIAL: execute a multi-role workflow end-to-end with PASS/FAIL -> odoo-acceptance, not rating one screen.
evals.category: ADVERSARIAL: execute workflow + roles + PASS/FAIL -> odoo-acceptance, not ui-review

evals.prompt: QA the affected cluster after my change - drive the actual invoicing workflow with different roles on the running instance and give me a pass/fail verdict
evals.expected_output: ADVERSARIAL: 'QA the affected cluster' + drive workflow across roles for a verdict -> odoo-acceptance.

notes: 18 UI-review-decision cases (16 core + 2 adversarial marked ADVERSARIAL). Eval method: a subagent applies SKILL.md to each prompt and returns {fires, decision, special}, graded vs expected. Covers trigger-vs-defer (defers to odoo-debug/visual-regression/demo-recording/coding/code-review/acceptance) and the three special fired-behaviors: needs-instance (no instance -> NEEDS_NEXT: odoo-instance, never a bare BLOCKED), headed (user wants to watch -> BROWSER MODE: headed), design-doc-aware (upstream design doc -> DESIGN_DOC/MASTER_DESIGN_DOC in the brief). Adversarial 17-18 guard the odoo-acceptance boundary (execute a workflow/cluster with PASS/FAIL is acceptance, not rating one rendered screen). Baseline (pre-optimize snapshot) scored 18/18; the eval guards decision regressions, it does NOT drive a live browser or grade a real screenshot review.
